result.topic_en: Riemann shows that the components of the resultant gravitational force derive from a potential function U satisfying Poisson's equation and vanishing at infinity, then begins a section on space as the medium of light, hypothesising that a light ray consists of transverse oscillations of ether particles that leave the density unchanged.

items.english: The simplest hypothesis by which the known phenomena of light can be explained is that each individual light ray is [the propagation of a form of motion in which all particles in a plane normal to the ray keep their relative positions and oscillate together within that plane].
